name: soundcheck
description: Music creation with an LLM co-producer
author: Adrian Eyre

scripts.build: pnpm engine:build && pnpm --filter @soundcheck/app build && node scripts/check-web-build.ts
scripts.test: node --test scripts/check-example-plugins.test.ts scripts/check-web-build.test.ts scripts/export-htdemucs.test.ts scripts/sign-windows.test.ts scripts/sign-macos.test.ts scripts/updater.test.ts && cargo test --workspace && pnpm engine:build && pnpm --filter @soundcheck/app test
scripts.lint: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && oxlint --deny-warnings && node scripts/check-example-plugins.ts
scripts.vst3:build: cmake -S desktop/vst3-host -B desktop/vst3-host/build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build desktop/vst3-host/build --config Release --parallel
